Evidence of Milestone Completion

1 user requirement specifications document accessible at https://github.com/wimsio/cardanopropertysolutions

・1 document of the dApp Front End design accessible at https://github.com/wimsio/cardanopropertysolutions

・1 document of the dApp Back End design accessible at https://github.com/wimsio/cardanopropertysolutions

・- developed Front End of the dApp hosted at https://cardanopropertysolutions.co/

・- developed Back End of the dApp hosted at https://cardanopropertysolutions.co/

Summary Report:

The milestone one evidence of achievement has been uploaded to the URLs above. There is a fully working web application for real estate listings. It allows agents and administrators to register, log in, complete forgotten password processes, and manage listed properties.
Administrators have access to a dashboard that allows them to manage and view reports, admins, users, agents, listed properties, and communications.
The web application is already connected to Nami, Lace, and Eternal wallets.
The added features are sufficient to commence Cardano Tokenization and Fractionalization sales and investments via Smart Contracts.
In short, the dApp is live, hosted, and fully functional.
